help.help_lead: Second-hand clothes from people worth following. Every piece is one of a kind.
help.buy_body: Every piece is one of a kind. Before you buy, you see its measurements in cm, taken flat, and its condition: new, like new, good condition or with flaws.
help.pay_body: You pay inside {brand}. By card always, and with OXXO or SPEI on purchases up to {threshold}. The piece is held while you pay and nobody else can buy it.
help.receive_body: Pick it up at a pickup point or get it at home. In Purchases, inside your profile, you can see how your order is going.
help.trouble_body: We're finishing our returns policy. If something isn't right with your order, write to us and we'll sort it out with you.
help.sell_body: Any account can sell after three steps: seller profile, payouts and review.
help.contact_body: Write to us through any of these.
help.pickup_body: You choose the point when you pay. Bring your order number when you pick up your piece.
help.home_note: The cost is added to the total when you choose home delivery at checkout.
help.pay_card: Credit or debit card, on any purchase.
help.pay_deferred: OXXO and SPEI, on purchases up to {threshold}. You have {hours} hours to pay.
help.pay_hold: By card, the piece is held for {minutes} minutes while you pay.
help.pay_inside: Always pay inside {brand}. Never transfer money straight to a seller.
help.sizes_lead: In second-hand, the tag size varies a lot between brands and years. That's why every piece comes with its real measurements in centimeters.
help.sizes_how_1: Take a garment of yours that fits the way you like.
help.sizes_how_2: Lay it flat on a table without stretching it.
help.sizes_how_3: Measure it at the same points and compare with the piece.
help.m_chest_cm: Armpit to armpit, laid flat. It's not the circumference.
help.m_length_cm: From the highest point of the shoulder to the bottom hem. For shorts, from the waist to the hem.
help.m_sleeve_cm: From the shoulder seam to the cuff.
help.m_waist_cm: Side to side across the waistband, closed and laid flat.
help.m_rise_cm: From the crotch seam to the top of the waistband.
help.m_inseam_cm: From the crotch seam to the leg hem.
help.sizes_note: We measure by hand, so there can be a 1–2 cm difference. If you have questions about a piece, write to us.
help.points_lead: Pick up your order at any of these points. You choose it at checkout.
help.points_empty: There are no active pickup points right now.
help.terms_p1: By using {brand} you accept these terms. If you don't agree with any part, please don't use the site.
help.terms_p2: {brand} may change these terms at any time. Changes apply as soon as they're published on this page.
help.privacy_p1: At {brand} we take care of your personal data. Here we explain what we collect, why and how we protect it.
help.privacy_collect_1: Contact details: name, email, phone and address.
help.privacy_collect_2: Payment details, processed securely by Stripe. {brand} doesn't store your card details.
help.privacy_use_2: Writing to you about your account or orders.
help.privacy_use_4: Sending you news, only if you allow it.
help.ip_p: The text, graphics, logos and images on this site belong to {brand} or to the people who sell on it, and are protected by Mexican and international intellectual property laws.
help.cookies_p: We use cookies so the site works and to improve your experience. You can set your browser to reject them, but some parts may stop working.
help.legal_contact_p: For any legal question, write to us at <link>{email}</link>.
help.a11y_p1: We want anyone to be able to use {brand}, including people with disabilities. We work to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1, level AA.
help.a11y_2: Enough contrast between text and background.
help.a11y_3: The whole site can be used with a keyboard.
help.a11y_5: The site works with up to 200% zoom.
help.a11y_feedback_p: If something keeps you from using the site or you have a suggestion, write to us at <link>{email}</link>.
